scope: Frozen local v12 candidate review; no remote staging, write, graph, target compile or device action

changes: v12 one-shot control/output/tmp names and release schemas are separate from frozen v11
v11 unconditional --run rc3 replaced by detached SSH signature check before release parser and output path
release_gate rechecks signature and compares exact signed ACK SHA with release ACK SHA; pre-graph release_gate equality repeats the check
static-check now reports identity and authority key only; it no longer validates stage2 local packet hashes, so its rc0 is only a smoke result

checks.static_fixtures: PASS: signed ACK accepted, altered ACK/wrong namespace/wrong key/missing signature denied; graph not invoked
checks.local_run_denial: PASS: rc3 NO_GO_OWNER_SIGNATURE before graph on Darwin
checks.key_provenance: ssh-add -L on Mac lists the exact pinned Ed25519 public key; this proves key availability to current Mac user, not original Herdr owner identity
checks.linux_memfd_pass_fds: CODE_REVIEW_ONLY: os.memfd_create flags=0, /proc/self/fd path, subprocess pass_fds=(fd) and lseek(0) are coherent; local host is Darwin, and no Linux or remote execution was performed, so runtime behavior remains unverified
checks.container_namespace: No new container or namespace launch in v12 diff; inherited FORBIDDEN and strace-based namespace audit remain, but no actual graph trace was produced

authority_limit: The Mac ssh-agent key is accessible to same-user Mac processes, including the outer coordinator. The signature establishes a Mac/gz02 machine boundary against remote same-UID JSON self-attestation; it does not cryptographically distinguish the original Herdr owner from the outer coordinator. Owner JSONL command/event/rc0 and exact ACK/signature SHA must be independently witnessed. Existing owner_provenance JSON fields are same-UID data and are not themselves proof.
release_limit: GO_STATIC_ONLY is not authority to stage or execute. Require exact runner readback, Linux memfd/pass_fds fixture, active-env v12 EVO19 gate, fresh outer release nonce, original owner session signature with independent JSONL witness, reviewed packet and one-shot execution-adjacent release. Strict owner cryptographic separation would require a dedicated key unavailable to outer same-UID processes.
